instruction: Write ONLY the test file `tests/test_schema_examples.py`: one test per example of `store/schema.py` taken from docs/TASK.md, this instruction, in example order, each test function named `test_<function>_example_<n>`. Do not write or modify `store/schema.py`: the author of the criterion is not the author of the code. pytest, fixtures from `tests/conftest.py`; Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
acceptance:
D=/tmp/morph/store-schema-judge; mkdir -p $D; S=$(date +%s)-$$; L=$D/acc-$S.log
cp tests/test_schema_examples.py $D/0-$S.py 2>/dev/null
(
 set -e
 python3 -m py_compile tests/test_schema_examples.py
 ruff check tests/test_schema_examples.py
 python3 -m pytest tests/test_schema_examples.py -q --tb=short
 python3 -m pytest -q --tb=short
) > $L 2>&1; rc=$?; cat $L; exit $rc
